name: sticky-note
title: Sticky note
description: A square of colored paper with a gum band, turned a little more than a page. Five pads, any size, written in marker. It can curl a corner, hang from a pin or a strip of tape, and grow a tick box that is ticked with a felt pen.

files.content:
import { box } from '@/lib/ink/shapes'
import { checkLines } from '@/lib/ink/shapes'
import { defineRecipe } from '@/lib/ink/recipes'
import { reveal, revealId } from '@/lib/ink/recipes/draw-on-ink'
import { MIRROR } from '@/lib/ink/recipes/paper-set-ink'

export const STICKY_BOX = { size: 17, inset: 11, top: 10 } as const

export const stickyNoteRecipe = defineRecipe<Record<string, never>>({
  id: 'sticky-note-decor',
  kind: 'sticky',
  layers: ['rest', 'checked'],
  pad: 6,
  draw(ink, { w, h }, _p, ctx) {
    const s = STICKY_BOX.size
    const x = w - STICKY_BOX.inset - s
    const y = STICKY_BOX.top
    const mirror = ctx.dir === 'rtl'
    const inMirror = (fn: () => void) => (mirror ? ink.group({ transform: MIRROR(w) }, fn) : fn())
    ink.layer('rest', () => inMirror(() => box(ink, x, y, s, s, { pen: 'ink.fine', corner: 2.5, opts: { alpha: 0.6 } })))
    ink.layer('checked', () =>
      inMirror(() => reveal(ink, { id: revealId(ctx.seed, 't'), lines: checkLines(ink.next('tick'), x + 2, y, s + 1), pen: 'greenfelt', box: { w, h }, revealWidth: 7, width: 1.15 })),
    )
  },
})

a11y: A note is a plain `div`. Give it `role="note"` or `as`-like semantics through props when it means more (for instance `role="group"` with an `aria-label` in a board of notes).

The gum band, curl, pin and tape are aria-hidden decoration. The tick box is drawing only unless you pass `onDoneChange`, and then it is a real checkbox (named by `doneLabel`, Space toggles, `aria-checked` follows `done`). A done note without it says "Done." to screen readers through hidden text; either way it is struck through, so meaning never rests on color or the drawing alone.
Ink on every pad is at least 9:1; struck-through text switches to ink-soft (5.8:1 or better). Tilt is zero in calm density.
Sticky text is real DOM and wraps at any size (`break-words`), so a note resized by its container never clips.
meta.usage:
import { StickyNote, StickyNoteContent, StickyNoteFooter, StickyNoteTitle } from "@/components/ui/sticky-note"

<StickyNote color="pink" curl fastener="pin" done={done} onDoneChange={setDone}>
  <StickyNoteTitle>urgent</StickyNoteTitle>
  <StickyNoteContent>call mum before six</StickyNoteContent>
  <StickyNoteFooter>from Ada</StickyNoteFooter>
</StickyNote>
